versions.content: function Subscribe [SWS_CM_00141] Upstream: RS_CM_00103 ara::core::Result < void > Subscribe ( std::size_t maxSampleCount) noexcept; Method to subscribe to a service event. If the Event is already in state kSubscribed or in state kSubscriptionPending at the time of the call, and the provided maxSampleCount value is the same as for the current subscription, the method shall return without action.
